Package dev.relism.flash.ext.validation

Interface Validation

All Known Subinterfaces:
ProtobufValidation
All Known Implementing Classes:
AvajeValidation, JakartaValidation, ProtovalidateValidation
public interface Validation
Verifies that a value satisfies the rules its own type declares.

One method, because that is the whole of what an engine does. An implementation wraps a validation library — flash-ext-validation-jakarta, flash-ext-validation-avaje — and an application installs exactly one of them: it is added as Validation, so a second one fails the boot naming both. What a rule means, which annotations exist and how they are enforced is the engine's business; this module knows only when to ask.

A format's codec calls it on a body it has just read, so a request that breaks a rule is a 422 and never reaches a handler.

  • Method Details

    • verify

      void verify(Object value)
      Verifies value against its type's rules.
      Throws:
      ValidationException - 422, listing every rule the value broke

    • describe

      default void describe(Constraints constraints)
      Declares what this engine's rules mean, for the published document.

      Called once per app, when the document is first built. Each engine speaks its own vocabulary — the jakarta constraints, its own annotations, both — and says so here; nothing in this module knows any of them. An engine that declares nothing still enforces; it just says nothing.

    • family

      static <F extends Validation> Optional<F> family(Services services, Class<F> family)
      The engine of a codec family, empty when none is installed. A family is a sub-interface of Validation that its codec's module defines, for values the generic engines cannot check; the codec asks for it here when it binds.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when an engine of the family was added as plain Validation, where its codec would never ask it, or when two were added
